Thanks for sending a pull request! Please fill in the checklist below.
For non-trivial changes, open an issue first so we can discuss the approach.
-->

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences explaining what this PR does and why. -->

## Motivation / Context

<!-- Link the issue this PR closes (e.g. `Closes #123`) or describe the
problem. Include screenshots, log excerpts, or design notes when useful. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor:`)
- [ ] Performance (`perf:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Tests (`test:`)
- [ ] Build / CI / chore
- [ ] **Breaking change** (also describe migration below)

## How was this tested?

<!--
List the commands run and the environments covered.
Examples:
  - `make lint`
  - `make test`
  - `make e2e`
  - Manual test: <steps>
-->

## Breaking change details (if applicable)

<!--
Describe what breaks, who is affected, and the migration steps.
Update CHANGELOG.md and the relevant docs in the same PR.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Public APIs have godoc / JSDoc in English.
- [ ] `docs/configuration.md` updated for new or renamed environment variables.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `Unreleased` section updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Documentation (English + Japanese) updated when user-facing.
